card.name: Words before nebulizer, saline, inhaler terms
card.fires_on: A modifier or brand-name piece that comes just before a delivery device or fluid word, such as jet before nebulizer, saline before lavage or cathartic, or chest before rubs. It also fires partway through inhaler and tablet brand names.
